build_scope: UI source commit with frozen bootstrap/build tools from d23f232; current-main network policy excluded from this binary and acceptance.
contracts: Sidebar tabs, pinned pages, folders and New Tab instantiate RustSidebarRow plain View hosts without Button/ButtonController instances. Their close children use RustActionView. Native comparison retains RowButton/SceneGlyphButton; address, palette/history/preference row hosts remain separately inventoried.

Rust ActionControl owns enabled/focused/on/visual/input state and RowPointer drag-versus-activation admission. The new row-pointer entry preserves drop semantics while sharing hidden/disabled/cancel/key/gesture policy. Native View focus/input/capture/AX/window/font/fallback adapters remain.

Pending row and close-child input is registered only while the Rust controller reports a pending press/key/gesture. Viewport callbacks snapshot those watches before dispatch, safely allow erasure/reentrant paint, and cancel clipped input synchronously even during GPU coalescing or fallback. Destruction removes watches; no whole-row-tree scan is added per frame.

Layout/close visibility use existing Rust row recipes. Sidebar Metal and workspace animation previews read either host through common adapters. Existing browser/domain stores, tab/folder IDs, selection/open/close/drop/context-menu callbacks remain native; metadata updates preserve live row nodes.

Shared acceptance checks actual host types, AX metadata, real Cocoa row context menu, Space/AX activation, folder collapse/expand, New Tab palette opening and title mutation during a pending click. Rust-specific acceptance checks row and child close scroll-out-and-back, disable/hide and late release on a replacement node. Existing native mouse drag/drop/close at both width limits, tree/space/split/persistence/fallback tests retain their assertions.

This full source includes the preceding split-pane action host migration and queued close identity correction, plus earlier header/footer/viewport/resize/trackpad work. Other node/control/container/menu/window/input ownership remains. No dependency, store, browser admission or persistence policy changed.
limits: Full automated acceptance does not prove complete functional/manual/release parity.
Native row identity and spec/domain data, other row/control/container/menu/window/input ownership and remaining preferred-size/outer placement policy remain open.
Manual hardware trackpad, IME candidates, VoiceOver, global RTL, scale/theme and GPU recovery remain open.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped dependency/license/notice acceptance remain outside this frozen UI lab.
